Whitby Abbey.extract: Whitby Abbey is a ruined Benedictine abbey overlooking the North Sea on the East Cliff above Whitby in North Yorkshire, England. The abbey church was a centre of Anglo-Saxon Christianity and was later rebuilt in the Gothic style. It was dissolved in 1539 and the ruins were damaged by German naval shelling in 1914. The ruins are a Grade I listed building and are owned by English Heritage.
